description:
Your retreat in the heart of Nashville! This charming cabin feel retreat offers a unique and comfortable space, perfect for a solo traveler, couple, or small family. 
You’ll love our central location!  
•Downtown Nashville: 10 min. ride to Music Cities best live venues and bars. 
•The Gulch:Trendy neighborhood with, shops, restaurants, and bars.
•The Nations:Up-and-coming area with shops and restaurants.
 •12 South: Charming neighborhood shops, restaurants, and iconic murals.

The space
We are on 1 acre of land in the heart of Nashville. The room is a cozy cabin like feel with basic amenities for quick meals like a microwave and coffee maker. We live in or rent out the main house area but it is totally seperate.

Guest access
You have your own entrance and exit, access to our shared back yard and fire pit as well as a seasonal garden.
